text: Election of the Vice Chair of the Special Committee on Governance under Municipal Code Chapter 27, Council Procedures, Appendix A-2, for a term of office ending when the Committee makes its final recommendations to City Council.

The Special Committee on Governance: 1. Elected Councillor Gord Perks as Vice Chair of the Special Committee on Governance for a term of office starting February 21, 2019 and ending when the Committee makes its final recommendations to City Council.
